test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 13 Feb, 2025 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Arjun was an expert developer, and it took him all of a __New York minute__ to solve the issue with the software.

options.text: A situation beyond the scope of one's imagination
A very short amount of time

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"a New York minute"** refers to a very short amount of time, emphasizing the fast-paced nature of life in New York City. (बहुत कम समय) • **Example:** The taxi arrived in a New York minute, just as the rain started pouring. • It is often used to convey the idea of speed or efficiency in completing a task or action. (तेजी से होने वाली क्रिया) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: A situation beyond the scope of one's imagination** (एक ऐसी स्थिति जो कल्पना से परे हो): Refers to something that is so extraordinary that it cannot be imagined. • **Example:** The magnitude of the disaster was beyond the scope of one's imagination. • **Option 2: An elaborate exhibition or presentation** (एक विस्तृत प्रदर्शन या प्रस्तुति): Refers to a detailed or grand display of something. • **Example:** The museum hosted an elaborate exhibition of ancient artifacts. • **Option 4: A very casual attitude** (बहुत ही आकस्मिक रवैया): Refers to a relaxed or informal manner of behaving. • **Example:** His very casual attitude towards deadlines annoyed his team members. 39:Taad, The correct answer is: **Vacant**.
